meaning:
adj

1a) at ease, secure
1b) at ease, careless, wanton, arrogant
subst

2a) one at ease

renderings.kjv: of those that are at ease
ye women that are at ease
to them that are at ease

elsewhere.note: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips…
In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of…
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
